nodes.Name: ErrNotFound
nodes.DocComment: ErrNotFound is the error resulting if a path search failed to find an executable file.

nodes.Name: lookExtensions
nodes.DocComment:
lookExtensions finds windows executable by its dir and path.
It uses LookPath to try appropriate extensions.
lookExtensions does not search PATH, instead it converts `prog` into `.\prog`.

If the path already has an extension found in PATHEXT,
lookExtensions returns it directly without searching
for additional extensions. For example,
"C:\foo\example.com" would be returned as-is even if the
program is actually "C:\foo\example.com.exe".

nodes.Name: lookPathExts
nodes.DocComment: lookPathExts implements LookPath for the given PATHEXT list.
